description: A person or a team as an image with an initial fallback. `status` adds a presence dot whose meaning lives in `statusLabel`, not in its colour; `shape="square"` reads as a team rather than a person. Copy: the name is the person's own, spelled as they spell it — the initial and the accessible name both come from it. `statusLabel` says what the dot means; a colour on its own says nothing.

props.name: name
props.description: Full name — first letter is used as the initial; whole name as aria-label.

props.name: size
props.description: Discrete sizes. Omit + use `fill` to size from parent.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill the parent (width/height 100%). For nesting inside icon buttons.

props.name: src
props.description: Optional image url. If it fails to load, the initial is shown instead.

props.name: shape
props.description: Circle by default. `square` is the rounded-rect form, for a team or an organisation rather than a person.

props.name: status
props.description: Presence dot pinned to the corner.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Localised word for the status, folded into the accessible name so the dot is never colour-only. Without it the raw status value is read.

example:
<Row gap={3}>
  <Avatar name="Ada Meridian" src={FACES[0]} />
  <Avatar name="Ben Calloway" src={FACES[1]} status="online" statusLabel="Online" />
  <Avatar name="Cleo Nakamura" />
</Row>
